id: title:jordanm-posthog:skip parsing events nobody is watching

review.posthog_relevance: Adds Kafka message metadata extraction and event lag observation, supporting warehouse ingestion and broker checks.
review.reason: Adds an incomingMessage struct and factory to extract token and distinct_id from Kafka headers, and observes event lag. This supports warehouse ingestion and broker checks.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies on supplied observations; no independent verification of production benefit or complete implementation.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No score assigned; tier requires assessment of broader systemic benefit and complete implementation, not just this hunk.

observations.behavior: Adds incomingMessage struct and newIncomingMessage factory to extract token and distinct_id from Kafka headers.
observations.posthog_connection: Parses Kafka consumer headers to populate token and distinct_id, supplying downstream parsing and broker checks.

observations.behavior: Changes incoming channel type from []byte to incomingMessage and its initialization.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows downstream consumers to distinguish header-derived metadata from raw payload, supporting the subscriber gate and Redis broker checks.

observations.behavior: Replaces direct msg.Value send with newIncomingMessage(msg) and adds observeEventLag(msg.Timestamp).
